dynamic_gmm_role_suggestion.note: Risk in this DS01 workflow is derived from RUL and highly deterministic by cycle. Lagged risk is intentionally excluded from dynamic OLS smoke testing.

direct_sensor_model.purpose: non-causal direct risk prediction from observed sensor state
direct_sensor_model.preprocessing: StandardScaler and PCA fitted only inside each training window
direct_sensor_model.features: current sensor PCs, one-cycle lags, first differences, and three-cycle means
